sameDayRetelling: My first heir Maren Ash, on a Guarded style I had levelled and with my own 30% bank rule, cut through the Warlord, Bloat Mother, Lich and Foundry Master to D28 carrying over $16,000. She fought the Lurker Queen's brood, a 44% bank rule sent her home, and the lurkers caught her on the way: 'hero at 2/51 hp', 'returned too late', with three unknown scrolls unused. The death screen replayed the fight and offered fixes. The Queen killed her heir the same way, so I wrote 'foe: boss → read silence', and two heirs later that rule fired on D28 and D33 and the Mirror King fell.

probes.clarity: I lost track several times: the forecast went from 'death 38% · avg $744/run' to '$377' and then '$781' as I nudged one threshold, and later showed 'death 75%' for a hero who then cleared the floor easily.
probes.decisions: I picked kite archers over boss focus even though 'compare outcomes' said 'same · turns on D8 Warlord' for both, and the next run was 'stuck · went home' at D7 among 'goblin archer · draws' lines, so the choice mattered, just not in the way the compare said.
probes.mastery: An hour ago I didn't know the Queen needed silence; now the graveyard reads 'Queenbane' and the log shows 'D28 · boss → read silence' before 'lurker queen · fell'.
probes.tension: I sweated at the first Warlord: 'WARLORD · ENRAGED', then 'hurt · collected' at '2/41 hp', with $533 carried and $308 secured.
probes.feel: 'GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN' and 'MIRROR KING DOWN' land as big banners, but at Normal speed in the sanctum a whole minute was mostly 'rest +5 hp' and 'warden · shifts', and the summary chip card ('D9–27 · 63% · +$1302', 17 chips) sat over the fight itself.
probes.surprise: My own 'read unknown' rule drank a mystery scroll at 45% HP on D13: 'recall scroll · recalled', and the run ended early, so I deleted the rule.
probes.expression: To a friend: a cautious knight who banks at 30% below D12, retreats under 20% when two foes close in, and reads silence on any boss past D28. The other 14 rules in the priority list came from packages and drills, not from me.
probes.story: 'Cut the captive down. No one weeps.' and the reel 'Slew the Mirror King. The bottom. Nothing below.' are the lines I remember. Most reels are flat ('Banked $533.').
probes.pacing: Check-ins were 2-5 minutes, with one obvious decision each (apply a fix, pick one of drill/legacy/forge). At Normal speed the first 7-27 floors are skipped into one chip card, and the deep floors crawl with rest lines.
probes.failure: Maren's death page gave 'lurker · D28 · hero at 2/51 hp', 'returned too late', the rule trace ('bank at 44% · going home'), and fixes tested on 12 replays, such as 'hp < 50% → read unknown · survives 12/12 · was 0/12 · reach D18 81→50%'.
probes.social: No other people; the heirs ('Maren', 'Niall', 'Orin', 'Petra', 'Quill') are names on a graveyard, not relationships.
probes.autonomy: Without being asked, I took hand control at D18 ('Hand control · awaits order') and used 'attack until' on a wraith and an ogre before releasing him.
probes.progression: Within the hour, the porter, scout ('SEND auto'), apprentice ('−$4714 · forge'), drillmaster, armourer and keeper took jobs off my hands; by the end gold sat at $61,979 with little left to buy.
probes.aesthetic: The camp at night, with its torch-lit cave mouth, and the torn red 'YOU DIED' banner over a lurker portrait are lovely. In the dungeon view the camera sits close and the chip overlays make the fight muddy. Audio was not assessed.
probes.return: After 8h I came back to '5 RUNS · 1 died · D33 · +$10823', a death with 6 fixes, and a 'Pick one ◇◇◇◇' choice. Oddly, that was less gold than the 4h absence's '+$14723'.
probes.attribution: The last King kill was mine: the log showed 'D33 · boss → read silence' and then 'D33 · HP 23% → bank'. Still, 'WHO DECIDED' credited me with only 'taught 3% · chores 62%', and most death traces ended on 'attack nearest · fired'.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: The death trace and 'WHO DECIDED' are clear. But the forecast swung ('avg $744' → '$377' → '$781'; 'death 75%' on a run that cleared), 'compare outcomes' said 'same' for a choice that stalled a run, the away report's '1 died' opened a replay rather than the death, and the report is a wall of numbers.

There were real trade-offs among the death fixes ('hp < 70% → return · survives 9/12' but 'reach D16 97→0%') and between forge aim and edge. Some picks were dominated ('Guarded … better 8/8'), and the 'Pick one' of drill/legacy/forge rarely felt weighed.

I learned counters (silence for the Queen, retreat when swarmed), and the results showed: 'Queenbane', then 'MIRROR KING DOWN'. The learning curve ended at the bottom of the dungeon within the session, and Ascension repeats it.

Carried versus secured gold was a real stake ('$2,820 lost', 'hurt · collected' at 2/41 hp, 'alert 7/8'). Across 23 runs the hero died 4 times and mostly cruised; most deep floors had no doubt in them.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Visual only; audio unassessed. Auto-speed between 1x fights and 4x travel works, and the boss banners hit. But dead stretches at Normal ('rest +5 hp' spam), the generic 'D7 · Foe · fell' label, and the chip card over the fight blunt it.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Several situations changed my configuration: the recall scroll ended a run, 'The monkey stole the leather.', starving with 'no light', the Queen's brood, kite archers stalling a run. But Ascension restarts at D1 rats, and the deep floors repeat warden, acolyte and echo.
Three of my rules sit at the top of a 17-row list that is otherwise packages and drills ('Guarded ranger', 'kite archers', 'Mirror rhythm'). The build is mostly the game's, lightly tuned by me.
The lineage, graveyard and King kill give me a retellable arc with a turn in it. Most reels are bookkeeping ('Banked $533.'), and the middle of each run is compressed into chip cards.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: Check-ins were 2-5 minutes with a clear decision. In a run, D1-27 are skipped while the deep floors drag at 1x. On cadence, 20m, 4h and 8h each felt distinct, though 8h paid less than 4h. A lot of admin goes through stacked sheets and a long priority list.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: The best part of the game: every death named its cause, the HP, the rules that did and did not fire, and replay-tested fixes, and the next heir starts automatically. The lapse: deaths that happened while I was away took several taps through the run list ('1 died' opened a replay first).
Weight 0; heirs are names, not relationships.
I had route choices (fens or crypt, foundry), hand control in the watch, and the option to ascend or stay in town. Most goals come from the forecast's 'Goal D9 · New record'.

Within a run: kit, floors, tames. Between runs: forge, Legacy ranks, tactics levels, heirs. Automation: porter, scout, apprentice, drillmaster, armourer, keeper. All came at a steady, legible cadence. The lapse: the dungeon's bottom fell in the first session and gold inflated to $61,979 with little left to buy.
Visual only: the camp and death banner art are strong. The watch view is zoomed in, muddy, and covered by chip and log overlays. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: Every return carried news (a death, 'Queen fell · 2 tries', D33) and a decision (apply a fix, pick drill/legacy/forge), and I acted within seconds. The lapse: the 8h return paid less than the 4h one ('+$10823' vs '+$14723'), so the payoff did not scale predictably with absence.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: My rules visibly decided key moments ('D28 · boss → read silence', 'D33 · HP 23% → bank', the 'read ?' recall). But 'WHO DECIDED' gives me 1-3%, most death traces end on package rules ('attack nearest · fired'), and most runs felt like the packages playing.

highlights: Death page: cause, HP, rule trace and 12-replay fixes ('survives 12/12 · was 0/12'), applied in one tap
Seeing my own rule fire in the log ('D28 · boss → read silence', then 'lurker queen · fell') and the Mirror King go down
Automation arriving as named workers (scout 'SEND auto', apprentice auto-forging)
gripes: Forecast numbers swing wildly and contradict outcomes ('death 75%' on a clean clear; '$744 → $377 → $781/run' from one threshold), and 'compare outcomes' said 'same' for a pick that stalled a run
Normal-speed watch: D1-27 vanish into a chip card that then covers the fight, while the sanctum crawls with 'rest +5 hp' lines
The dungeon bottom fell in the first session (~65 active min + 12 h away); gold inflated to $61,979 and Ascension restarts at D1 rats
